BiblicalUsage: A habitation is the place God chooses to put His name. Moses commands Israel to seek the place the LORD shall choose out of all their tribes to put His name there, even unto His habitation shall ye seek, and thither thou shalt come. One verse, one direction: go where God has put His name.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe this verse still rules worship, for God chooses the place and we come to it, and I hold that seeking His habitation is the first step of seeking Him.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
